Zapraszamy na dwie rundy FMa w Rzeszowie!

Zwróć uwagę, że na tych zawodach NIE będą organizowane standardowe konkurencje takie jak 3x3.

Druga runda odbędzie się jedynie jeżeli w konkurencji weźmie udział 8 zawodników.

Dokładny adres zawodów zostanie podany zarejestrowanym zawodnikom.

Wszystkie informacje na poszczególne tematy odnoszące się zawodów można znaleźć w odpowiednich zakładkach. W razie pytań należy kontaktować się z organizatorami.

---------
 
We invite you to two rounds of FMC in Rzeszów!

Please note that standard events such as 3x3 will NOT be held at this event.

Second round will only take place if 8 competitors participate in an event.

The competition will take place in Rzeszów, in the Wilkowyja district, near the RENTA construction equipment rental.
The exact address of the competition will be given to registered competitors

All information on individual topics related to the competition can be found in the appropriate tabs. If you have any questions, please contact the organizers.

items.name: Warsaw Cube Masters 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkJSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2ec91b0578bf841894ad746e0643e0b8635a99e3/logo_WCM.png)

#### Warsaw Cube Masters powraca!

Zapraszamy do Warszawy zarówno starych wyjadaczy jak i nowych zawodników aby razem spędzić czas w atmosferze kostkowego święta. Poprzednia edycja zaowocowała rekordem świata w wykonaniu Macieja Czapiewskiego, mamy więc nadzieję, że i tym razem nie zabraknie znakomitych wyników i rekordów. Liczymy, że uda się nam spędzić miło czas zacieśniając stare przyjaźnie i zawiązując nowe.

Zachęcamy do przejrzenia wszystkich zakładek, znajdują się tam naprawdę przydatne informacje, a jeżeli nie wyczerpały one pytań, do kontaktu z nami za pomocą formularza dostępnego pod przyciskiem "Kontakt".

---

#### Warsaw Cube Masters returns!
We invite both old timers and new competitors to Warsaw to spend time in atmosphere of cubing festivity. Previous edition resulted in spectacular world record by Maciej Czapiewski so we hope that this time there will be a lot of great results and records as well. We also hope to nurture old cubing friendships and create some new while spending good time at the competition.

Please visit all tabs, you will be able to find there very useful informations, and if they will not answer all of your questions don't hesitate to contact us via form available under "Contact" button.

items.information:
##### 🇧🇷
O **Pé Vermelho 2023** é um campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar:

* Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register).
* As inscrições vão até o dia **20/10/2023**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes.
* Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará.
* É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.
* O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição.
* Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
* Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento!
* Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande seus questionamentos para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores!
* Divirta-se!

---

##### 🇺🇸
**Pé Vermelho 2023** is an **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate:

* All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register) tab.
* Registration closes on **10/20/2023**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies.
* Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating.
* All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
* The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition.
* If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
* All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in.
* If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the [organization](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers!
* Have fun!

---

items.name: BMME 3x3 Day 2023
items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch BMME 3x3 Day 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar. Diesesmal findet das Turnier in den Räumlichkeiten des BMME statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. 

Da dies ein sehr kleines, ruhiges und auch kurzes Turnier wird sind generell keine Gäste erlaubt (da wir auch von der Räumlichkeit begrenzt sind) - falls jedoch ein Teilnehmer einen Gast dabei haben muss, zb. weil du Minderjährig bist und du deinen Erziehungsberechtigten dabei haben willst, dann schreibt uns bitte noch vor dem Turnier eine E-mail mit einer Begründung und mit dem Namen des Gastes.

Generell herrscht absolute Ruhe während des Gesamten Turnieres (ausgenommen von den Pausen) da es sich hauptsächlich um Blind Events sowohl als auch um Fewest Moves handelt.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the BMME 3x3 Day 2023 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner and Pranjal Khan and delegated by Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

This competition is going to be quite small, short and especially quiet and because of this no guests will be allowed at this competition (also because it is a small room).
If you have a good reason why a guest should accompany you (e.g.: you are a minor and you want to have your legal guardian with you), then please let us know before the competition via email (include the name of the guest and the reasoning).

It has to be absolutely quiet during the whole competition (except during the breaks) because we mostly have Blind and Fewest Moves events only.

items.name: NCR Please Be Quiet 2023
items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

### (EN)
### Please be quiet

Most of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

### Note for new competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), or the Fewest Moves Challenge, this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

### Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

### (FR)
### Silence s'il vous plaît

La plupart des épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer.

### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs

Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)) ou le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas.

### Liste de diffusion

Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions dans le sud de l'Ontario et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information:
Välkomna till Gotland Open 2023, den första WCA-tävlingen på Gotland!
Tävlingen hålls på Gangvide Farm på Gotlands östkust ca 1 mil söder om Ljugarn. Gangvide farm är ett mysigt ställe där man kan äta färska ägg till frukost och ta ett dopp i ån!
Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 
Det blir en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla 17 WCA-grenar.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information, speciellt fliken "resa".
*Om du inte tävlar i 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD behöver du inte närvara under lördagen*


-----

Welcome to Gotland Open 2023, the first WCA competition on the island of Gotland!
The competition is held at Gangvide Farm on the east coast of Gotland about 10 km south of Ljugarn. Gangvide Farm is a cozy place where you can eat fresh eggs for breakfast and even take a swim in the river!
Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.
It's a 2,5 day competition with all 17 WCA events.

Please read all the information tabs because they contain valuable information, especially the travel tab.
*If you are not competing in 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD you do not need to be present during Saturday.*

Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Flen! Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken **koncept**. Notera också att en sängplats (vandrarhemsstandard) över natten samt frukost ingår i anmälningsavgiften, i samma hus som tävlingen genomförs i.

--

A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Flen! Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the **concept** tab. Also note that a hostel style bed and breakfast is included in the registration fee, in the same house as the competition will take place in.

In the Titan FMC 2023, the main objective is to find the most efficient solution to the cube, using the fewest possible number of moves. Participants will put their ability to visualize patterns, apply algorithms, and make quick decisions to the test in pursuit of the optimal solution.

Let the competition begin!

items.name: Voula Summer Open 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbUUvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--25a11a161841639a3cff2ecfb046c27deb82697e/Cubestore_VSO23_post.jpg)

Το Voula Summer Open 2023 είναι ο 3oς WCA διαγωνισμός στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Είμαστε περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών "Road to Greek Nationals" εστιάζουμε σε κάθε διαγωνισμό σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε στο ελληνικό κοινό τα αγωνίσματα του One Handed/Λύση με ένα χέρι και του Fewest Move Challenge (FMC)/Δοκιμασία λύσης με τις λιγότερες κινήσεις πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος μας είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα της Ελλάδας προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα WCA events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

The Voula Open 2023 is the third competition this year in Greece. We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration!
During  each "Road to Greek finals" competition, we focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we are aiming to bring the events One Handed and Fewest Move Challenge (FMC) closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all WCA events will be familiar to the competitors.

Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.name: Stockholmsligan Final 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkomna till finaltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2023! Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information.

Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

A warm welcome to final competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2023! More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.

The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.name: FMC Canada 2023
items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## FMC Canada 2023
### [EN]
This competition is **Canada's championship for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves** as we will not hold the event at [Canadian Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CanadianChampionship2023). The top-three Canadian competitors will be recognized for the national podium.

This competition will have competitors simultaneously competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves at different locations across Canada with one winner.

This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).
### [FR]
Cette compétition est le **Championnat canadien de 3x3x3 résolution optimisée (ou FMC)** car nous n'organiserons pas cette épreuve lors du [Championnat canadien 2023] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CanadianChampionship2023). Les trois premiers compétiteurs canadiens seront reconnus pour le podium national.

Dans le cadre de cette compétition, des compétiteurs participeront simultanément à l'épreuve du 3x3x3 résolution optimisée à différents endroits au Canada et un seul gagnant sera désigné.

Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).

---

## Locations / Lieux
### [EN]
Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2023#24263-locations-lieux) for more details.
### [FR]
Merci de regarder [l'onglet lieux](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2023#24263-locations-lieux) pour plus de détails.

---

## Notice of Filming and Photography / Avis de droit à l'image
### [EN]
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
### [FR]
Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

This competition holds only "Please Be Quiet" events - 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multiblind and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves Challenge. As the name suggests, it is crucial to maintain silence during all events. We'll have sufficient amount of breaks when it is ok to make some noise.

Эти соревнования включают в себя только дисциплины, на которых необходимо соблюдать тишину - 3х3х3 вслепую, 4х4х4 вслепую, 5х5х5 вслепую, 3х3х3 Мультиблайнд и 3х3х3 на количество ходов. Как следует из названия, чрезвычайно важно сохранять полную тишину во время всех дисциплин. У нас будет достаточное количество перерывов, во время которых можно будет пошуметь.

venue.name: BMME
venue.details: Folgen Sie den Schildern, um den Veranstaltungsort zu betreten. / Follow the signs to enter the venue.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch BF Vienna 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Simon Praschl und delegiert von Šimon Borovský und Viktor Kalmar. Diesesmal findet das Turnier in den Räumlichkeiten des BMME statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. 

Da dies ein sehr kleines, ruhiges und auch kurzes Turnier wird sind generell keine Gäste erlaubt (da wir auch von der Räumlichkeit begrenzt sind) - falls jedoch ein Teilnehmer einen Gast dabei haben muss, zb. weil du Minderjährig bist und deinen Erziehungsberechtigten dabei haben willst, dann schreibt uns bitte noch vor dem Turnier eine E-mail mit einer Begründung und mit dem Namen des Gastes.

Generell herrscht absolute Ruhe während des Gesamten Turnieres (ausgenommen von den Pausen) da es sich um Blind Events sowohl als auch um Fewest Moves handelt.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the BF Vienna 2023 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner and Simon Praschl and delegated by Šimon Borovský and Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

This competition is going to be quite small, short and especially quiet and because of this no guests will be allowed at this competition (also because it is a small room).
If you have a good reason why a guest should accompany you (e.g.: you are a minor and you want to have your legal guardian with you), then please let us know before the competition via email (include the name of the guest and the reasoning).

It has to be absolutely quiet during the whole competition (except during the breaks) because we have Blind and Fewest Moves events only.

items.name: Rahn Education Leipzig 2023
items.information:
**Deutsch**

Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur ersten Competition in **Leipzig** in der Geschichte der WCA. Nach über 12 Jahren findet endlich wieder eine Competition in Sachsen statt und wir, das Orga-Team freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig und ein motiviertes Orga-Team. Lasst uns gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass die Competition **Rahn Education Leipzig** ein traditionelles Event in der WCA wird. 

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**


**English**

We cordially invite you to the first competition in **Leipzig** in the history of the WCA. After more than 12 years, there is finally a competition in Saxony and we, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. You can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig and a motivated organizational team. Let's work together to ensure that the **Rahn Education Leipzig** competition becomes a traditional event in the WCA.

**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.name: Save Ramir Cubing Kazakhstan 2023
items.information:
Соревнование проводится с благотворительной целью. Все вырученные средства пойдут в помощь сбору средств на лечение 3-летнего ребенка с инвалидностью Рамира Ковалевского, с диагнозом «Спинальная мышечная атрофия 2 типа», который нуждается в  самом дорогостоящем лекарственном препарате в мире, ZOLGENSMA.

Главный спонсор соревнования – компания «Леовит». Соревнование проводится при поддержке школы №157 и общественного фонда «Alem Asar».. 

Смотрите наш аккаунт в Instagram (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers), чтобы узнавать новости и подробную информацию о соревновании!

Соревнование будет проходить в спортзале школы №157.

Будем рады видеть вас на соревновании! 

Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында өткізеді. Жарыстан бүкіл түскен қаражат спиналды бұлшық атрофия диагнозына шалдыққан мүгедекке 3 жасар бала Рамир Ковалевскийге әлемде ең бағалы дәрі «ZOLGENSMA» сатып алу үшін қаржы жинауға және көмектесуге бағыттайды

Жарыстың бас демеушісі – «Леовит» компаниясы. Жарыс мектептiң №157 мен «Alem Asar» қоғамдық қорының көмегiмен өткiзіледi. 

Біздің Instagram аккаунтымыздың парақшасында (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) жаңалықтар және жарыс туралы ақпарат көре аласыздар!

Жарыс мектептің №157 спорт залында өткізіледі.

Сіздің жарысқа белсенді ат салысып қатысқаныңызға қуаныштымыз! 


 
The competition is organised for charity. All the proceeds made from the competition will be spent for fundraising for helping 3-years old kid, Ramir Kovalevsky, in his spinal muscular atrophy medical treatment to purchase him the most expensive cure in the world, ZOLGENSMA.

The Leovit company is the main sponsor of the competition. The competition is organised with the help of school #157 and Alem Asar social foundation.

Watch our posts in our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) to learn the news and more information about the competition! 

The competition will be set in the sports hall of the school #157.

We will be happy to see you at the competition!

items.name: Please Be Quiet Joburg 2023
items.information:
### This is not a normal competition

We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is focused on blindfolded events, with a single fewest move attempt to keep things interesting.

If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province.

**Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund.

### Venue

The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue.
There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information:

1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number.
2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with.
3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this.

Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address.

### Guests

Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. 

### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information:
Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen.

### Vänligen notera:
* **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).**
* **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information.
* **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret.
* **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.**

---

Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition.

### Please note: 
* **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).**
* **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information.
* **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office.
* **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

Hay un límite de 15 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o a los delegados de la WCA. 

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 15.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegates.

Welcome to the Swedish FMC Championship 2022! The event 3x3x3 FMC is not held at the [Swedish Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishChampionship2022) this year. ![](https://i.imgur.com/Upxb5EP.png)

Why SILENCE?

We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :)

We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure.

We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it.

We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. 
  
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. 
 
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

Happy cubing!

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.name: Abierto del Mirador 2022
items.information:
Bienvenidos al Abierto del Mirador 2022, nos complace traerles nuevamente un torneo a la Provincia de Buenos Aires. Nuestro evento contará con 10 categorías oficiales de la WCA distribuidas en 17 rondas.
Solo se harán devoluciones del total del pago ($1000) a quienes estén en lista de espera una vez lleno el cupo de 60 competidores siempre y cuando se confirme que no asistirán al torneo antes del mismo, no se harán devoluciones luego del evento.
Se aceptarán los registros por orden de llegada del e-mail correspondiente con comprobante a la casilla de correo del organizador.
Pedimos que dentro de las posibilidades se atienda al torneo con un (1) acompañante por cuestiones de espacio físico en el lugar del torneo.
Pedimos puntualidad a todos y recomendamos llegar al menos 15 minutos antes de cualquier categoría en la que el competidor vaya a participar.

Welcome to Abierto del Mirador 2022, we are pleased to bring you again a tournament to the Province of Buenos Aires. Our competition will feature 10 official WCA events distributed in 17 rounds.
Refunds of the total payment ($1000) will only be made to those who are on the waiting list once the quota of 60 competitors is filled as long as it is confirmed that they will not attend the tournament beforehand, no refunds will be made after the event.
Registrations will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis with proof of receipt to the organizer's e-mail address.
We ask to attend, within the possibilities, with a maximum of one (1) companion for reasons of physical space at the tournament site.
We ask for punctuality to all and recommend to arrive at least 15 minutes before any category in which the competitor will participate.

items.information:
8 años después de nuestra última competición, os presentanos el Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. 
Un torneo de speedcubing en esta maravillosa isla del mediterraneo donde podrás disfrutar de 2 días de competicion con rondas de casi todas las categorías oficiales, que se realizarán en el mismo hotel en que podrás hospedarte.
En la edición de 2014 contamos con hasta 6 nacionalidades diferentes, y ahora ha llegado el momento de superarlo. 
¡Os estaremos esperando!


8 years after our last competition, we are glad to present you the Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. 
A speedcubing tournament on this wonderful Mediterranean island where you'll be able to enjoy 2 days of competition with rounds of almost all official categories, which will take place in the same venue you'll stay. 
In the 2014 edition we had up to 6 different nationalities, and we plan to overcome it this year.
So don't be afraid to join us.
We'll be waiting for you!

venue.address: 6138 Student Union Blvd, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z1

items.information:
* **Regular 3x3x3 will NOT be held at this competition**.
* You don't need to show up until shortly before your first event is started (but coming earlier to help out would be very much appreciated).
* All competitors will be **expected to help out** in order for the event to run smoothly.
* Cutoffs, advancement conditions, and event start times may change depending on registration totals - any changes will be emailed out to registered competitors in advance.
* This competition has only blindfolded and fewest move events. Spectators and competitors must **remain silent whenever anyone is competing**, to allow for concentration. 


Masks will not be required at this competition, but you are welcome to use one. Nor will we be seeking proof of vaccination status for competitors or guests. As an expected and still valuable courtesy, we simply ask that those experiencing any COVID-19 like symptoms or those with a recent positive COVID-19 test refrain from attending. Competitors may arrange with the organisational team for a full refund if they need to opt out due to the onset of illness or a positive test. Naturally we have a COVID-19 Information tab here on the website to share any useful considerations pertaining to personal wellness at the competition and as a place to communicate any additional changes to the new health order - if the government re-introduces restrictions such as proof of vaccination, we will update the website and email registered competitiors.

Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we require that each competitor bring **at most 1 guest**.

Mistrzostwa Polski w Speedcubingu to najważniejsza impreza sezonu w kalendarzu każdego polskiego speedcubera. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach World Cube Association.

Po niezwykle udanej edycji 2021 Mistrzostwa Polski ponownie zostaną przeprowadzone w miejscu wyjątkowym jakim jest Olivia Star! Poraz kolejny rywalizacji na najwyższym poziomie będą towarzyszyły niesamowite widoki 34 piętra Olivia Star - największego wieżowca w północnej Polsce!

---

Polish Speedcubing Championship is the most important event of the year of every Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it continues to attract best competitors who compete for national titles in all events sanctioned by World Cube Association.

After successful 2021 edition this year's championship will be held in a special place - Olivia Star! Once again competing at the highest level will be accompanied by amazing views from 34th floor of Olivia Star building - highest scyscraper in northern Poland!

items.name: Oslo Open 2022
items.information:
## Informasjon

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2022! Dette er den første kube konkuransen i Oslo siden 2015! Vi gleder oss!
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). 

Påmeldingen åpner lørdag 28. mai kl 16:00 norsk tid.
Det koster 150 NOK å delta. 
Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. 
Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet.

Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo.

## Information

English:

Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015!
You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

The registration opens Saturday 28 of May at 6:00 PM Norwegian time.

We follow local Covid restrictions. As of today, there are no special requirements or restrictions in Oslo.

items.information:
### General Information

This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that due to the nature of the festival the venue will be extremely noisy, and this is outside of our control. The competition will be taking place in a large tent, and it is June, so dress warmly.

### Competitor Tickets

Please register for the competition and select your events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldClassicAfrica2022/register), and then pay for your registration at:
https://www.quicket.co.za/events/175059-speed-cubing-arnold-classic-africa/#/
Tickets for competitors cost R200, which includes access to the rest of the expo and sport festival.


### Guests

Spectators are welcome, but will need to pay for entrance to the expo. Tickets can be bought online through [WebTickets](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420) or paid for at the door. Various pricing options are available depending on whether you wish to attend for the whole weekend or just one day.
**[Tickets for guests](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420)**

### Volunteering

We will require volunteers to support with running and judging on the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact the organisers. Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing.

venue.details: Senate Chamber is located on the second floor of the Ohio Union, Rhodes Center is located at the Ohio Expo Center

items.information:
Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. 

Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab.

**Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves
**Day 2:**  5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks
**Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb

Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis.

Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. 

All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:

1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

OR

2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Monday, March 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

**Refund Information: Due to venue financial requirements, no refunds will be issued after March 3rd, 2022 unless there are extreme circumstances. These circumstances include the following: **
* **Competitor contracts COVID-19 within 14 days of the competition and must withdraw**
* **Other Injury or Sickness that would prevent the competitor from attending**
* **Competition as a whole is cancelled**
* **Any specific excuse deemed acceptable by an organizer or delegate**
**We understand that some may need to cancel their registration after the refund date due to unforseen events or circumstances; however, due to financial constraints, we will only be refunding competitors if they meet one of the previously mentioned conditions. We thank you for your understanding.**

**[FR]**  

**Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.**

Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**.

Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA.

Note : **un (1) accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir.

Note : Dans le cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA annule la compétition. Les mises à jour importantes seront affichées sur ce site et envoyées directement par courriel aux compétiteurs.

**[EN]**

**As per the Quebec government's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www.quebec.ca/en/health/health-issues/a-z/2019-coronavirus/progress-of-the-covid-19-vaccination/covid-19-vaccination-passport/places-and-activities-requiring-covid-19-vaccination-passport), all competitors and their (single) guest must present a valid proof of vaccination and a valid piece of ID with photo in order to enter the venue. Also, a welcome questionnaire will have to be filled, see the [Vaccination proof tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) for more details. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the government updates its regulations.** Moreover, note that **individuals arriving from outside of Canada need to qualify as [fully vaccinated travellers](https://travel.gc.ca/travel-covid/travel-restrictions/covid-vaccinated-travellers-entering-canada) and follow the canadian government policies detailed on the website.**

Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new conditions** and there are things to be particularly attentive to.

Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing).

This is the fourth Copper Country Cubing competition, and we're looking forward to welcoming you to the Michigan Upper Peninsula! It's been a long time since anyone has been able to compete, so this event features two long events on Saturday evening and the more common NxN events on Sunday. We plan to host another competition this Fall with more of the non-NxN puzzles, so look out for it!

As this competition takes place on the Michigan Technology University campus, it is subject to Michigan state laws, University campus policies, and WCA policies. We will monitor all of these sources for any changes to safety protocols and requirements. Please note that if community or regional health problems surface again or severely worsen, the competition may be forced to cancel. 

There is a 40 person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please sign up early to ensure a spot, and please read the "Waiting List" tab for additional information on registration for the competition.

If the competition is running ahead of schedule and has enough competitors we would love to add an additional round to 3BLD, 3OH, and/or 6x6. Additionally, please note that the rounds are scheduled with more time than usual to account for stationary groups and sanitation time.

venue.address: 72 Kemp St, Kilbirnie, Wellington 6022, New Zealand

items.information:
Wellington Mind Games 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. 

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

**The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

venue.address: 7 Paru Paru Road, Nelson 7010, New Zealand

items.information:
New Zealand Nationals 2020 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2020 will crown the National Champions in all 17 official events, over the course of 3 days.

venue.details: Main events will be held in the room Storparketten, on the ground floor. Long events will be held in nearby side rooms.

items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2020! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 8 sekunder eller 5 minuter.

Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla 17 WCA-grenar. Om du inte tänker delta i 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 FMC, 3x3x3 Multi-BLD eller Megaminx så behöver du inte vara på plats i Huskvarna under fredagen.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Observera: I år kommer det finnas kvalgränser i grenarna 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD och 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. Mer information under detta under fliken "kvalgränser".

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, prispengar och titeln Svensk Mästare.

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2020! Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 8 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year will be a 3 day competition, hosting all 17 WCA events. If you are not competiting in 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 FMC, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind or Megaminx, then there is no need to be present in Huskvarna on Friday.

Please read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information. Please note: For this year´s edition, there will be qualification limits for the following events: 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD and 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. More information on this can be found under the tab "qualification limits". 

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, however only competitors representing Sweden are eligeble for medals, prize money and the Swedish Champion titles.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns.

Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia.

---------------------------------------------------------------

Registration is open to all, of all nationalities.

Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few.

Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.name: Tirol Open 2019
items.information:
2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol!
Durch Tirol zieht sich ein langes Tal, das Inntal, welches das breiteste Tal in Tirol ist, für erste Besucher aber trotzdem eng erscheinen könnte.

Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab!

______
2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol!
Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well.

The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!

items.information:
Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve.
Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition.
**Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.**

**REPAS** :
Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition.
Samedi soir, pour 10€ : 
* Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser)
* Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau

Dimanche soir pour 15€ : 
* Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J)
* Un dessert, comme le samedi

**LASER GAME** :
Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€.
Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! 

---
You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event.
We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition.
**Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.**

**DINNERS**:
On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue.
Saturday evening for 10€:
* "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us)
* A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake

Sunday evening for 15€:
* A big pizza (to be chosen on the day)
* A dessert, like on Saturday

**LASER GAME**:
On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€.
Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

-CubeDepot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor!

**Please observe silence during FMC and blindfold events.**

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information:
This will be the second Copper Country Cubing (Michigan Technological University) competition, in Michigan's great Upper Peninsula. 

The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. Check the schedule to see if the events at that time will be in the second floor ballroom, first floor alumni lounge, or ground floor commons.

We are excited to be bringing all 18 official WCA events to the area, which doesn't get many competitions. The first CCC competition had only 8 events and 23 competitors, so this time we're making it bigger and better! Friday is reserved for big BLD and feet, so you can arrive just for Saturday and Sunday if you aren't interested in that subset of events.

items.name: UK Championship 2019
items.information:
Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above.

**Qualification Requirements**: If you do not meet the qualification requirements in competition *before* 11 October 2019, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the [Qualification tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UKChampionship2019#9139-qualification) to see all times required.

**Final Round Advancements**: For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 3x3x3 with Feet - 4 UK competitors; 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3x3 Cube - 8 UK competitors.

**Please Note**: As this is the UK Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

items.name: Reto Chignahuapan 2019
items.information:
Chignahuapan, *pueblo mágico*, es el principal productor de esferas en todo el país, bello por folklor y sus paisajes naturales como la laguna de Chignahuapan, las cascadas de Quetzalapan, las aguas termales y sus bosques. Han pasado casi 8 años desde el primer Reto Chignahuapan, es hora de traer uno nuevo y no hay otra mejor manera que con un gran torneo.

Este torneo es posible gracias al staff del ***Puebla Rubik’s Team*** y al ***Gobierno municipal de Chignahuapan.***
![](https://i.imgur.com/17KskVW.jpg)

Chignahuapan, *pueblo magico*, is the main manufacturer of Christmas spheres in Mexico. Chignahuapan is beautiful because its folklore and its natural landscapes are amazing. 8 years have passed since the first *Reto Chignahuapan*, it's time to bring a new one but in shape of 2019

This tournament is supported to ***Puebla Rubik's Team*** staff and ***Chignahuapan municipal government***

items.information:
(HR)

Croatian Nationals 2019 je trinaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. 

--------------

(EN)

Croatian Nationals 2019 is the 13th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia.  Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

items.name: SCS1 Almaty Open Air 2019
items.information:
Летние соревнования будут проводиться на открытом воздухе на территории жилого комплекса возле Школы спидкубинга. Будут расставлены шатры защищающие участников от солнца и дождя.
На соревнования необходимо взять с собой солнцезащитный крем и головоломки, которые вы будете собирать. На территории есть детская площадка и футбольное поле, где можно будет поиграть (мячи не предоставляем).
Официальная церемония открытия состоится 20 июля 2019 года в 10:15.
За участие всем будут выданы крутые памятные медали, а за призовые места во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы и медали!

items.name: GLS Cup II 2019
items.information:
GLS Cup 2019 is a cycle of 6 official WCA competition in Gdańsk (Northern Poland). 
From many years we cooperate with hotel Novotel Marina. Thanks to this we can provide the highest standard of cubing 
environment. Elegant ferniture, profesional audiosystem and perfect lighting. For ourdisposal we have beautiful garden with beach access. Moreover we have dedicated restaurant and foyer as a rest area. 

GLS League is connection of 6 competition. We have big rankings system. 
- General classification of all events
- 3x3x3 classification for kids, 
- 3x3x3 for parents

At the main venue we have big rollup with the names of GLS record holders. It is our tradition to refresh the names after each record. After the first day we organise cubers integration. 
Next to the hotel we have parking area and shop. 
If you want to join us, you are most welcome!

items.information:
Welcome to this blind events only competition in Tullinge, just outside Stockholm! We will only have blindsolving events at this competition. However, registration is free and the time-limits are lenient, so we would like to see many of you gathered for this competition in April! 

Please read through all the tabs on this page to get all the information you need for this competition. The main event of this competition is **3x3x3 Blindfolded**. If you have any further questions, feel free to contact the organizers using the contact information on this page. 

We are not allowed to wear outside shoes inside the venue, and the floor tend to get a bit cold as it is in a basement. Therefore, a good tip is to bring some slippers or inside shoes to keep your feet warm during the day.

-----

Varmt välkomna till denna tävling med bara blindgrenar i Tullinge, strax utanför Stockholm! Vi kommer bara ha blindgrenar på denna tävling. Det är dock gratis att delta och alla time-limits är generöst satta, så vi hoppas se många av er på denna tävling i april!

Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att få all information om denna tävling. Tävlingens huvudgren är **3x3x3 med Ögonbindel** Om du har ytterligare frågor så går det bra att kontakta arrangörerna genom kontaktinformationen på denna sida.

Det är inte tillåtet att ha på sig utomhusskor inne i tävlingslokalen och golvet tenderar och bli ganska kallt då lokalen ligger i en källare. Därför är ett bra tips att ta med er ett par innetofflor eller inomhusskor för att hålla era fötter varma under tävlingen.

items.name: No Place For DNF Spring 2019
items.information:
The main event of this competition is 3x3 Fewest Moves.

-We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. If you miss your group, you will be disqualified from that event.

-Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

-Food and drinks are **NOT** permitted inside the main room.  You may eat in the cafeteria next door.There are a few restaurants within a ten minute drive. 

-Live results will be posted on cubecomps.com.

-All proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate® club of Emmaus High School. Proceeds will not be donated to ADL directly.

-CubeDepot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor!

**A local newspaper photographer will be taking pictures of the competition. If you would not like to have your picture taken, please let us know.**

**Please observe silence during FMC and blindfold events.**

**This competition will not be holding the famous 3x3 speedsolve event. We still encourage newer competitors to try out other events!**

items.information:
**English:**
Welcome to Mental Breakdown Norway 2019
This competition focuses on the five most advanced events we have: FM, 3 blind, 4 blind, 5 blind and multi blind. This is the first time such a competition is held in Norway. It is open to anyone who wants to attend, but since the events are quite demanding, we do not expect many first timers. Note that we do not compete in normal 3x3 at this competition! Also note that we only allow 30 competitors.

**Norwegian:**
Velkommen til Mental Breakdown Norge 2019!
Dette er en WCA-konkurranse som fokuserer på de fem mest krevende eventene vi har: FM, 3-blind,4-blind, 5-blind og multiblind. Dette er den første av sitt slag i Norge. Alle som ønsker å delta er velkommen, men siden eventene er ganske krevende, så vi regner med at de fleste som kommer har deltatt på konkurranse før. Legg merke til at vi ikke konkurrerer i vanlig 3x3 i denne konkurransen! Legg også merke til at vi kun godtar opp til 30 deltakere.

items.name: Cube Weekend Sint Michielsgestel 2019
items.information:
Een compleet weekend met 2 overnachtingen, maaltijden, snacks en natuurlijk een vol wedstrijdprogramma. Lees vóór je aanmelding de uitgebreide informatie op de website van [Speedcubing Nederland](http://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/kubusweekend2019). Er is een beperkt aantal bedden voor gasten. Gasten betalen dezelfde prijs als deelnemers. Het is mogelijk om de wedstrijd bij te wonen als bezoeker, maar alle bezoekers moeten worden aangemeld. Bezoekers betalen geen bijdrage, maar kunnen geen gebruik maken van het eten en drinken.


A complete weekend with 2 overnight stays, meals, snacks and a complete competition programma. Before you register, please read the detailed information on the website of [Speedcubing Nederland](http://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/kubusweekend2019). There is a limited number of beds available for guests. Guests will pay the same price as competitors. It is possible to visit the competition as a visitor during the events, but all visitors must be registered. Visitors will not pay a fee, but cannot use the food and drinks.
